do.name: Gravina gorge hike to Belvedere Murgia Timone
do.detail: Drop into the ravine from Porta Pistola, cross the 130 m Tibetan bridge and climb to the belvedere for the classic full-sassi panorama.

do.name: Rupestrian cave churches of the sassi and Murgia
do.detail: Frescoed rock churches on both sides of the gorge: Madonna de Idris on its crag, San Pietro Barisano, and about 150 more in the park.

do.name: Palombaro Lungo underground cistern
do.detail: A cathedral-sized water cistern under Piazza Vittorio Veneto, hand-carved chambers up to 15 m high that held 5 million litres.

do.name: Sunset aperitivo over the sassi
do.detail: At golden hour the stone city glows; take a terrace drink or the belvederes near Via Ridola and Piazza Giovanni Pascoli.

do.name: Sleep in a cave hotel
do.detail: Restored grotto dwellings in the sassi now house cave hotels, vaulted stone rooms that are the defining Matera overnight.

do.name: Festa della Bruna
do.detail: Matera's 600 year old feast on 2 July: dawn procession, mounted knights, then the crowd tears apart the papier-mache cart at night.

do.name: Casa Grotta di Vico Solitario
do.detail: A furnished cave house showing how sassi families lived with animals and cistern before the 1950s evacuations; entry costs a few euros.
